summary: Implemented patch-level transform and optional coordinate output in GridPatchDataset (monai/data/grid_dataset.py). New args: transform (applied to each array's patch) and with_coordinates (default False; when True each element is (patch, coords) with coords = patch start index in the unpadded array). Added tests/test_grid_patch_dataset.py covering default output, coordinates, and transform. Tests were not run and nothing was committed, per instructions. Choices to confirm: with_coordinates defaults to False to keep existing output; transform is applied per array patch.
